name: SUSE Certified Administrator in SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15
name_ja: SUSE認定アドミニストレーター（SLES 15）

logistics.format: Question-based proctored exam (delivered via Questionmark / Pearson VUE)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 2, foundational: 1. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: A one-year enterprise Linux profile supports associate administration knowledge from an established vendor; English-only knowledge testing and general infrastructure scope limit its security-specific delivery signal.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Enterprise Linux administration with a one-year profile supports associate SUSE knowledge. Multiple-choice assessment, general infrastructure coverage and limited external recognition provide less execution evidence than a live administration exam.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded general enterprise-Linux scope provides entry technical knowledge, but assessment is multiple choice only. At a one-year profile, limited independent recognition and no practical execution keep the signal foundational.
